pages.title: Who runs and backs us
pages.text:

Dmitri Beaumont serves as pemberton-analytics.test chief financial officer. Selma Lowther is the chief operating officer of pemberton-analytics.test. Engineering at pemberton-analytics.test answers to CTO Anika Ingram. pemberton-analytics.test is backed by Silverbirch Investments.
